verdict.rationale: The SDK's own command API documents managing background processes (docs-43), and Cloudflare positions sandboxes for AI agents and CI/CD systems (docs-24). Filesystem watching with event callbacks (docs-4, docs-33) allows reactive processing, but there is no documented way to set up scheduled or self-triggering automations. A community report also notes that containers auto-shutdown when they stop receiving requests (comm-5), which limits truly autonomous background operation. Missing for 10: scheduling/trigger configuration (cron or event-driven automation setup), documented long-running background lifecycle without inbound requests, and hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.
